senses.gloss: (cmp. סָנַן) [to sting; (of taste) to be pungent; (of color) to be bright, polished]; (of temperature) to be cold. Mekh. Yithro s. 4 רחק ממנה צ׳ if he is removed from it, he is cold.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 4:8:2">Y. Pes. IV, 31ᵇ</cite> top <he>שלא תִיצַן</he> that she (the ass in heat) may not cool off (before copulation).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 87:7">Gen. R., s. 87</cite> <he>איקונין … וצָ׳ דמו</he> he saw his father’s image before him, and his blood grew cold; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 87:7">ib.</cite> s. 98 <he>וצינן</he> (corr. acc., or <he>וצוּנָּן</he>); a. e.—V. <cite ref="R00211"><he>צוֹנָן</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to become cold. Y. Hor. III, 46ᵈ יָצֵן he must become cold (suppress his passion); לא ה׳ if he does not cool off (what shall he do)? Ib. ויהא מֵיצַן and he will cool off.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>ראה … מיד ה׳</he> he saw his father’s image and at once was cooled off (v. supra).—
Gen. R. s. 20 שמא תִיצּוֹן (Nif.), v. next w.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:9">Ab. Zar. III, 9</cite> <he>ישן יוּצַן</he> if it is an old oven, it must be allowed to cool off (before being used again); <cite ref="Pesachim 26b">Pes. 26ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 27a">27ᵃ</cite>
<cite ref="Shabbat 53a:11">Sabb. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>לצַנְּנָהּ</he> to cause the perspiring animal to cool off, opp. <he>לחממה</he> to keep her warm.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 74b">B. Bath. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>סירס … וצי׳ הנקבה</he> he emasculated the male (Leviathan), and cooled the female.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 10:2">Ex. R. s. 10</cite> <he>ומְצַנְּנִין אותו</he> (not <he>ומצנן</he>) they caused the stove to cool off.

<cite ref="Pesachim 118a">Pes. 118ᵃ</cite> the angel Gabriel said, <he>ארד וַאֲצַנֵּן וכ׳</he> let me go down and cool the furnace &c.; a. e.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98">Gen. R. s. 98</cite>, v. supra.]
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98">Gen. R. s. 98</cite>, v. supra.—Part. <he>מְצוּנָּן</he>; f. <he>מְצוּנֶּנֶת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:5">Ḥull. III, 5</cite> <he>המצ׳</he> an animal suffering from frost; <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 3:19">Tosef. ib. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 4:19">IV</cite>), 19.
<cite ref="Shabbat 129a:10">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite> <he>הקיז דם ונ׳</he> if one has chills after blood-letting.
<cite ref="Yoma 77a:3">Yoma 77ᵃ</cite> <he>אלמלא לא נִצְטַנְּנוּ וכ׳</he> if the coals had not been cooled off on their transmission from the hand of the Cherub &c.
<cite ref="Sotah 11b">Sot. 11ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:14">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>מִצְטַנְּנוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="J00642"><he>יָרֵךְ</he></cite>; a e.
